name: task-memory-marketplace
description: Turn the mistakes made during a task into reusable, size-bounded lessons in Claude Code memory.

plugins.name: task-memory
plugins.description: End-of-task retrospective that merges corrections into topic-grouped lessons with seen-counters, and keeps the always-loaded memory index within budget, and raises a lesson through a PreToolUse hook at the moment Claude is about to repeat it.
